d: Jet black, voluminous hair flows down past the waist with choppy, face-framing bangs and a wavy texture. The pale, wide eyes have small pupils and a vacant expression, set on a youthful face with a mature air. A slender build is dressed in a short, high-collared white dress featuring a gold-buckled front closure, paired with black opera gloves and black high-heeled pumps with ankle straps. A white ID badge hangs from a red lanyard around the neck, and several small metallic pins are attached to the bottom hem of the dress.
